as_told.title: Recovery of missing Toughbooks and hard drives from a glacier lake

plain: A helicopter pilot named Jake Barber, who says he flew missions to recover UFOs, says his team found a person who led them to a glacier lake high in the Sierra Nevada mountains of California. There, he says, hard drives sat sealed in a steel container about 25 feet underwater. In one telling he says they came from Toughbooks, a kind of rugged laptop, and credits a man named Don Paul Bales, and he tells it as a piece of hidden evidence his team says it brought back.
